test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Starting from his dairy, Bhiku went to the city to give milk. First he went 3 km towards East. Then, he turned right and went straight for 4 km. Then, he turned right and went straight for 3 km. Finally, he took a right turn, walked 2 km and stopped at the railway station. In which direction is the railway station located with respect to Bhiku's Dairy?
solution:
According to the given information the distance diagram is shown below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/273e6236c91e8189fd571a4596332ad76e487a8973e42c3b96eec8bc7bb5aa8d.png] 

Bhiku start from point O (Dairy) and he stopped at point D (Railway Station) where point D is situated in the **south** with reference to point O.

Here, The railway station is situated in the south direction of the dairy.

Hence, **Option (3)** is the answer.
